Key Responsibilities

- Design and develop backend services that process real-time and event-driven data.
- Build and maintain scalable data pipelines for ingestion, transformation, and downstream consumption.
- Develop internal services and APIs to support platform workflows and operational needs.
- Integrate systems with external services and counterparties, ensuring seamless operation.
- Translate high-level requirements into reliable, production-grade software solutions.
- Implement safeguards and controls within backend workflows to ensure predictable behavior and system stability.
- Monitor, maintain, and improve production systems, including incident response and post-incident analysis.
- Collaborate closely with engineering, research, and operations teams to evolve the platform and ensure alignment with business objectives.

Overview

- The Senior Python Backend Engineer position is a critical role within our algorithmic trading fund, focusing on designing and implementing core backend systems.
- The role requires building and operating services that process real-time data, integrate with various external systems, and ensure continuous production stability.
- This position emphasizes design quality, operational stability, and meticulous attention to detail, crucial for maintaining high-performance systems.
- Familiarity with financial markets can be advantageous, aiding in understanding system behavior, edge cases, and reliability in live trading environments.
- The engineer will operate in a systems-focused capacity, collaborating with cross-functional teams to enhance platform capabilities.
- This role involves significant responsibility and ownership over core platform components, requiring an ability to think holistically about system behavior and end-to-end processes.
- Engineers are expected to ensure that their contributions enhance the platform's overall reliability and performance.
- This position is based in Mumbai and is part of the BFSI sector, offering a dynamic and challenging environment for professionals in the trading technology space.
- Candidates will have the opportunity to work closely with engineering, research, and operations teams, contributing to the evolution of our algorithmic trading platform.
- The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of building backend systems in Python, with a deep understanding of real-time data processing and event-driven architectures.
- The role demands a strong focus on system correctness, observability, and fault tolerance, supporting the company's mission to deliver high-quality trading solutions.

Requirements

- Strong proficiency in Python with extensive experience in building backend systems.
- Experience working with real-time or event-driven architectures, ensuring high performance and reliability.
- Solid understanding of asynchronous programming and concurrency models.
- Demonstrated experience in building and integrating APIs (REST, WebSockets, or similar).
- Strong database fundamentals, including experience with both relational and non-relational systems.
- Familiarity with message queues or streaming systems like Kafka or RabbitMQ.
- Proven experience designing systems for reliability, observability, and long-running production workloads.

We are growing and are looking to expand our team with some rockstar engineers.

We are looking for an experienced Java Full Stack developer to help us enhance the product, ensure we scale seamlessly to grow and serve a global userbase of several millions, and venture into newer business avenues with our product/technology.

Role overview

We are looking for a Backend Application Developer (Java+Python) with experience in building high-performing, scalable, enterprise-grade applications.

Professional profile we are looking for

Must have

3-5 years of experience in developing highly scalable applications as a backend developer (Java + Python). Python(Django) fluency is a must.
Working knowledge/experience with the Spring Boot framework.
Knowledge of the Java Concurrency Utilities framework.
Solid understanding of micro-services and REST APIs

Bonus

Knowledge or understanding of Apache Kafka, Cloud computing in AWS
Understanding of any front end frameworks (Angular/Vue/React)

Python Backend Engineer 3

Behavioral traits that will help you succeed in this role

1. Collaborative - We are a tight team and need to move fast!
2. Communicative - We are solving some really niche and complex problems. Communication is key. This also means good documentation.
3. Analytical - Our product is quite complex. Critical thinking is a must for you to succeed.
4. Growth-oriented - If you focus on your growth diligently, the product will get better for sure :)

Over time, the role will expand into dashboarding, ETL/data engineering, and data science/ML/AI enablement to turn connected product and operational data into actionable insights.

Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
3+ years of experience developing or supporting software applications, APIs, user interfaces, data workflows, or analytics tools.
Proficiency with Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript
Familiarity with SQL, data visualization, and application environments hosted or deployed on AWS.
Strong communication skills, with fluency in English.

N/A

Connected product, IoT, or secure cloud-based software applications.

Job Description

This role focuses on building and maintaining scalable, secure backend systems using Python and cloud technologies. The candidate will design RESTful APIs and microservices, integrate third-party solutions like Pindrop, and develop high-performance applications on AWS. The role involves working extensively with cloud services (Lambda, S3, DynamoDB), implementing CI/CD pipelines, ensuring system observability, and contributing to infrastructure automation. Additionally, the candidate will support contact center transformation initiatives, including integrations with Amazon Connect, while collaborating across teams to deliver reliable and efficient solutions.

Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain RESTful APIs and microservices using Python.
Integrate and support Pindrop solutions including authentication, fraud detection workflows, and SDK/API usage.
Architect secure, scalable, and high-performance backend applications.
Integrate backend services with relational and NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, and DynamoDB.
Write clean, efficient, testable code following best practices for performance, maintainability, and security.
Design and deploy cloud-native applications using AWS services including EC2, Lambda, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, API Gateway, and IAM.
Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or GitLab CI.
Set up monitoring, logging, and observability using CloudWatch, CloudTrail, and Splunk logging.
Collaborate on infrastructure automation using CloudFormation and Terraform.
Integrate solutions with AWS services like Lambda.
Use of AI-assisted coding in development workflows.
Assist in migration projects from legacy contact center platforms to Amazon Connect.
Contribute to frontend work (React/Angular/Vue) when needed and ensure smooth integration with backend APIs Qualifications
6+ years of experience in backend development and cloud-based application engineering.
5+ years of experience with Python.
Extensive experience with AWS services including EC2, Lambda, S3, IAM, RDS, DynamoDB, and VPC.
Experience with AWS SDKs, reporting, analytics, and troubleshooting.
Deep experience designing and implementing RESTful APIs and microservices.
Hands-on experience with SQL and NoSQL databases.
Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, and security best practices.
Proficiency in CI/CD pipeline setup and maintenance.
Experience with CloudFormation and Terraform for infrastructure as code.
Understanding of networking and cloud security best practices.

Nice to Have

Experience with Amazon Connect integrations, including API usage, contact flow design, routing, queues, and call-flow troubleshooting.
Hands-on experience with Pindrop integrations including risk scoring, authentication workflows, and troubleshooting.
Knowledge of telephony concepts and SIP trunking.
Experience or knowledge of using AI and LLM models.
Basic understanding of React, Angular, or Vue. js frameworks.
Understanding of responsive UI/UX design principles.

We offer:

Culture of Relentless Performance: join an unstoppable technology development team with a 99% project success rate and more than 30% year-over-year revenue growth.
Competitive Pay and Benefits: enjoy a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, language courses, and a relocation program.
Work From Anywhere Culture: make the most of the flexibility that comes with remote work.
Growth Mindset: reap the benefits of a range of professional development opportunities, including certification programs, mentorship and talent investment programs, internal mobility and internship opportunities.
Global Impact: collaborate on impactful projects for top global clients and shape the future of industries.
Welcoming Multicultural Environment: be a part of a dynamic, global team and thrive in an inclusive and supportive work environment with open communication and regular team-building company social events.
Social Sustainability Values: join our sustainable business practices focused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.
